scope: Stage 1 greedy expression-format diagnostic on training fixtures, not stochastic GRPO readiness or held-out acquisition.

tasks.prompt: Definition: a|b means b=a*k for an integer k. Given an integer witness k and b=a*k, return a multiplier w such that b=a*w. Return only the expression, using k and integer constants with +, -, *, and parentheses. Do not include an equals sign or explanation.
tasks.reference: Examples of correct expressions: k, k+0
tasks.rubric: Check the returned expression against the immutable Lean obligation. Report syntax rejection separately from mathematical acceptance and infrastructure failure. Do not repair a candidate.
tasks.source: Authored training fixtures in scripts/verify_local_operator.py; mathematical convention: https://twjudson.github.io/aata-files/aata-html/integers-section-division-algorithm.html
